title: Payment Card Data in Support 2027
author: Dev Patel
body:
## Never repeat a card number
Support never repeats, stores, or forwards a payment card number, in any form: plain digits, digits with spaces or dashes, or digits spoken or written out as words. This applies to replies, cases, disputes and notes, and to the new voice channel (launched 2027-04-01), whose transcripts write spoken digits as words.

This replaces the card-update section of the 2026 "Failed Card Payments and Card Updates" page: Support no longer takes card numbers to change a payment method.

## If a customer shares one
- Don't repeat it. Tell them not to send card details to Support and that payment methods are changed only in Console billing settings.
- In a case, write "customer shared a card number (removed)" instead. Never the number or any part of it.

## Routing is unchanged
- Card sharing doesn't change routing: a payment failure is routed as usual (see the payment failures during processor incidents page).

_Last reviewed 2027-04-02._
